title: Hard times in Harlem before leaving in 1942
summary: He fed his group for two months from his night-club earnings, since New York and Harlem were dead before the war.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So I did. I'd go out to different clubs at night. I'd be beat, you know, but yet and still, I'd be making this money at night, and I fed my group for almost -- let's see -- about two months, I fed them.
Because the group didn't have any work?
That's right. It was bad in New York at that time. Harlem was nothing.
I see. Once the war came in.
Harlem kind of shut down, huh?
When the war came in, or right before the war?
